name: Student Board Member, Mt. Diablo Unified School District
what_you_do: Sit with the school board as the voice of students. You go to board meetings, give input on decisions, and lead the Student Advisory Committee. You are seated with the board and can take part in discussions and cast preferential votes.
who_can_apply: Current Mt. Diablo Unified students who will be in 11th or 12th grade in the year they serve. You need at least a 2.0 grade point average and must be enrolled in 20 credits.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
duration: One school year, July 1 to June 30
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-2027 were due May 29, 2026. The district picks a new Student Board Member each year. The next dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Student Board Member Application when the district posts it. For 2026-2027 it was sent by email to Laura Juranek at juranekl@mdusd.org, due May 29, 2026.
notes: Board meetings are usually on the second and fourth Wednesday of the month, starting at 6:00 PM. The Student Advisory Committee advises the Student Board Member. Its 2025-26 meetings were at Concord High School. The district is at 1936 Carlotta Drive, Concord.
